strategy_2_taec11.entry_rule_if_bid_ask: take the single side with positive model-implied convergence value after executable entry and round-trip costs
strategy_2_taec11.exit_rule_long_no: exit at first checkpoint where market YES reaches/falls below the frozen 24h model YES probability; otherwise force open exit
strategy_2_taec11.exit_rule_long_yes: exit at first checkpoint where market YES reaches/exceeds the frozen 24h model YES probability; otherwise force open exit
strategy_2_taec11.name: TAEC11_two_sided_all_edge_convergence
strategy_2_taec11.short_no_interpretation: Synthetic short NO is economically equivalent to long YES and is not counted as a second signal; equivalent execution routes may be compared only if historical executable quotes permit.
